verses.text: Di Lord call to Moses, and speak to am from di Tent of Meeting, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and talk to dem, ‘When any man of una bring one offering to di Lord, una go bring una offering of di livestock, of di herd and of di flock.
If im offering na burnt offering of di herd, make am offer one male without blemish. E go offer am at di door of di Tent of Meeting, so that e go dey accepted before di Lord.
E go lay im hand on di head of di burnt offering, and e go dey accepted for am to make atonement for am.
E go kill di bull before di Lord. Aaron pikin man dem, di priests, go bring di blood, and sprinkle di blood round about on di altar wey dey at di door of di Tent of Meeting.
E go skin di burnt offering, and cut am into im pieces.
Di pikin dem of Aaron di priest go put fire on di altar, and lay wood in order on di fire.
Aaron pikin man dem, di priests, go lay di pieces, di head, and di fat, in order on di wood wey dey on di fire wey dey on di altar,
but im inner parts and im legs e go wash with water. Di priest go burn all on di altar, for burnt offering, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
If im offering na of di flock, of di sheep or of di goats, for burnt offering, e go offer am one male without blemish.
E go kill am on di north side of di altar before di Lord. Aaron pikin man dem, di priests, go sprinkle im blood round about on di altar.
E go cut am into im pieces, with im head and im fat. Di priest go lay dem in order on di wood wey dey on di fire wey dey on di altar,
but im inner parts and im legs e go wash with water. Di priest go offer all, and burn am on di altar. E na burnt offering, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
If im offering to di Lord na burnt offering of birds, e go offer im offering of turtledoves or of young pigeons.
Di priest go bring am to di altar, wring off im head, and burn am on di altar. Im blood go dey drained out on di side of di altar.
E go take away im crop with im feathers, and cast am beside di altar on di east part, for di place of di ashes.

E go tear am by im wings, but e no go divide am completely. Di priest go burn am on di altar, upon di wood wey dey on di fire. E na burnt offering, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.’”
When anyone go offer one meal offering to di Lord, im offering go be of fine flour. E go pour oil on am, and put frankincense on am.

E go bring am to Aaron pikin man dem, di priests. E go take from dere im handful of im fine flour and of im oil, with all im frankincense. Di priest go burn di memorial portion of am on di altar, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
Wetin remain of di meal offering go be Aaron own and im pikin man dem own. E na most holy part of di offerings of di Lord made by fire.
When you offer one offering of one meal offering baked for di oven, e go be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
If your offering na one meal offering of di griddle, e go be of fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil.
You go part am in pieces, and pour oil on am. E na meal offering.
If your offering na one meal offering of di frying pan, e go dey made of fine flour with oil.
You go bring di meal offering wey dem make of dem things to di Lord. E go dey presented to di priest, and e go bring am to di altar.
Di priest go take from di meal offering im memorial portion, and go burn am on di altar, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
Wetin remain of di meal offering go be Aaron own and im pikin man dem own. E na most holy part of di offerings of di Lord made by fire.
No meal offering, wey una go bring to di Lord, go dey made with leaven, because una no go burn any leaven, nor any honey, as offering made by fire to di Lord.
As one offering of firstfruits una go offer dem to di Lord, but dem no go dey burnt on di altar for pleasing aroma.
Every offering of your meal offering you go season with salt. You no go allow di salt of di covenant of your God to dey lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you go offer salt.
If you offer one meal offering of firstfruits to di Lord, you go offer for di meal offering of your firstfruits grain wey dem roast with fire, crushed new grain.
You go put oil on am, and lay frankincense on am. E na meal offering.
Di priest go burn di memorial portion of am, part of di crushed grain and part of di oil, with all im frankincense. E na offering made by fire to di Lord.’”
If im offering na one sacrifice of peace offerings, if e offer am of di herd, whether male or female, e go offer am without blemish before di Lord.
E go lay im hand on di head of im offering, and kill am at di door of di Tent of Meeting. Aaron pikin man dem, di priests, go sprinkle di blood around on di altar.
E go offer from di sacrifice of di peace offerings one offering made by fire to di Lord: di fat wey cover di inner parts, and all di fat wey dey on di inner parts,
and di two kidneys, and di fat wey dey on dem, wey dey by di loins, and di cover on di liver, with di kidneys, e go remove.
Aaron pikin man dem go burn am on di altar on top of di burnt offering, wey dey on di wood wey dey on di fire. E na one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
If im offering for one sacrifice of peace offerings to di Lord na of di flock, male or female, e go offer am without blemish.
If e offer one lamb for im offering, e go offer am before di Lord.
E go lay im hand on di head of im offering, and kill am before di Tent of Meeting. Aaron pikin man dem go sprinkle im blood around on di altar.

From di sacrifice of di peace offerings e go offer one offering made by fire to di Lord: im fat, di fat tail whole, wey e go remove close to di backbone, and di fat wey cover di inner parts, and all di fat wey dey on di inner parts,
and di two kidneys, and di fat wey dey on dem, wey dey by di loins, and di cover on di liver, with di kidneys, e go remove.
Di priest go burn am on di altar. E na food of di offering made by fire to di Lord.
If im offering na one goat, e go offer am before di Lord.
E go lay im hand on im head, and kill am before di Tent of Meeting. Aaron pikin man dem go sprinkle im blood around on di altar.
E go offer from am im offering, one offering made by fire to di Lord: di fat wey cover di inner parts, and all di fat wey dey on di inner parts,
and di two kidneys, and di fat wey dey on dem, wey dey by di loins, and di cover on di liver, with di kidneys, e go remove.
Di priest go burn dem on di altar. E na food of di offering made by fire, for pleasing aroma. All di fat na di Lord own.
E go be one perpetual statute throughout una generations, for all una dwellings, say una no go eat any fat or any blood.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘If anyone sin through error against any of di commandments of di Lord concerning things wey no suppose dey done, and go do any one of dem:
if di anointed priest sin so as to bring guilt on di people, make am offer for im sin wey e don sin one young bull without blemish to di Lord for sin offering.
E go bring di bull to di door of di Tent of Meeting before di Lord. E go lay im hand on di bull head, and kill di bull before di Lord.
Di anointed priest go take some of di blood of di bull, and bring am to di Tent of Meeting.
Di priest go dip im finger for di blood, and sprinkle some of di blood seven times before di Lord, before di veil of di sanctuary.

Di priest go put some of di blood on di horns of di altar of sweet incense before di Lord, wey dey inside di Tent of Meeting. E go pour out all di blood of di bull at di base of di altar of burnt offering, wey dey at di door of di Tent of Meeting.
E go take from am all di fat of di bull of di sin offering: di fat wey cover di inner parts, and all di fat wey dey on di inner parts,
and di two kidneys, and di fat wey dey on dem, wey dey by di loins, and di cover on di liver, with di kidneys, e go remove,
as dem take am from di ox of di sacrifice of peace offerings. Di priest go burn dem on di altar of burnt offering.
But di skin of di bull, and all im flesh, with im head, and with im legs, and im inner parts, and im dung,
even all di bull, e go carry go outside di camp to one clean place, wia dem dey pour out di ashes, and burn am on wood with fire. Where di ashes dey poured out e go dey burnt.
If di whole congregation of Israel sin through error, and di thing hidden from di eyes of di assembly, and dem don do any of di things wey di Lord command say dem no suppose do, and dem dey guilty,
when di sin wey dem don sin against am dey known, di assembly go offer one young bull for sin offering, and bring am before di Tent of Meeting.
Di elders of di congregation go lay dem hands on di head of di bull before di Lord, and dem go kill di bull before di Lord.
Di anointed priest go bring some of di blood of di bull to di Tent of Meeting.
Di priest go dip im finger for di blood, and sprinkle am seven times before di Lord, before di veil.

E go put some of di blood on di horns of di altar wey dey before di Lord, wey dey inside di Tent of Meeting, and e go pour out all di blood at di base of di altar of burnt offering, wey dey at di door of di Tent of Meeting.
E go take all im fat from am, and burn am on di altar.
Na so e go do to di bull. As e do to di bull of di sin offering, so e go do to dis. Di priest go make atonement for dem, and dem go dey forgiven.
E go carry di bull outside di camp, and burn am as e burn di first bull. E na sin offering for di assembly.
When one ruler sin, and do through error any one of all di things wey di Lord im God command say e no suppose do, and e dey guilty,
if im sin wey e don sin dey made known to am, e go bring for im offering one goat, one male without blemish.
E go lay im hand on di head of di goat, and kill am for di place wia dem dey kill di burnt offering before di Lord. E na sin offering.
Di priest go take some of di blood of di sin offering with im finger, and put am on di horns of di altar of burnt offering, and e go pour out im blood at di base of di altar of burnt offering.
E go burn all im fat on di altar, like di fat of di sacrifice of peace offerings. Di priest go make atonement for am concerning im sin, and e go dey forgiven.
If anyone of di common people sin through error, for doing any of di things wey di Lord command say dem no suppose do, and e dey guilty,
if im sin wey e don sin dey made known to am, e go bring for im offering one goat, one female without blemish, for im sin wey e don sin.
E go lay im hand on di head of di sin offering, and kill di sin offering for di place of burnt offering.
Di priest go take some of im blood with im finger, and put am on di horns of di altar of burnt offering, and e go pour out all im blood at di base of di altar.

E go remove all im fat, as dem remove di fat from di sacrifice of peace offerings. Di priest go burn am on di altar for pleasing aroma to di Lord. Di priest go make atonement for am, and e go dey forgiven.
If e bring one lamb for im offering for one sin offering, e go bring am, one female without blemish.
E go lay im hand on di head of di sin offering, and kill am for sin offering for di place wia dem dey kill di burnt offering.
Di priest go take some of di blood of di sin offering with im finger, and put am on di horns of di altar of burnt offering, and e go pour out all im blood at di base of di altar.

E go remove all im fat, as dem remove di fat of di lamb from di sacrifice of peace offerings. Di priest go burn dem on di altar, on top of di offerings of di Lord made by fire. Di priest go make atonement for am concerning im sin wey e don sin, and e go dey forgiven.’”
“‘If anyone sin, in dat e hear di voice of one adjuration, and e na witness, whether e don see or don know, if e no tell am, e go bear im iniquity.

Or if anyone touch any unclean thing, whether na di carcass of one unclean wild animal, or di carcass of unclean livestock, or di carcass of unclean creeping things, and e dey hidden from am, e dey unclean, and guilty.
Or if e touch di uncleanness of man, whatever uncleanness wey one go dey unclean with, and e dey hidden from am, when e know am, e dey guilty.
Or if anyone swear rashly with im lips to do evil, or to do good, whatever e go speak rashly with one oath, and e dey hidden from am, when e know am, e dey guilty for any of dem.
E go come be say, when e dey guilty for any of dem, e go confess dat wherein e don sin.
E go bring im trespass offering to di Lord for im sin wey e don sin, one female from di flock, one lamb or one goat, for sin offering. Di priest go make atonement for am concerning im sin.
If im means no reach to bring one lamb, e go bring for im trespass wey e don commit two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to di Lord, one for sin offering, and di other for burnt offering.
E go bring dem to di priest, wey go offer first dat wey be for sin offering, and wring off im head from im neck, but e no go divide am completely.
E go sprinkle some of di blood of di sin offering on di side of di altar, and di rest of di blood go dey drained out at di base of di altar. E na sin offering.
E go offer di second for one burnt offering, according to di ordinance. Di priest go make atonement for am concerning im sin wey e don sin, and e go dey forgiven.

But if im means no reach to two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, e go bring for im offering for di sin wey e don sin di tenth part of one ephah of fine flour for sin offering. E no go put oil on am, neither e go put frankincense on am, because e na sin offering.
E go bring am to di priest, and di priest go take im handful of am as im memorial portion, and burn am on di altar, on top of di offerings of di Lord made by fire. E na sin offering.
Di priest go make atonement for am concerning im sin wey e don sin in any of dem things, and e go dey forgiven. Di remainder go be di priest own, as di meal offering.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“If anyone commit one trespass, and sin through error, for di holy things of di Lord, e go bring im trespass offering to di Lord, one ram without blemish from di flock, according to your valuation in silver by shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary, for one trespass offering.

E go make restitution for wetin e don do wrong for di holy thing, and go add di fifth part to am, and give am to di priest. Di priest go make atonement for am with di ram of di trespass offering, and e go dey forgiven.
If anyone sin, and do any of di things wey di Lord command say dem no suppose do, though e no know am, yet e dey guilty, and go bear im iniquity.

E go bring one ram without blemish from di flock, according to your valuation, for one trespass offering, to di priest. Di priest go make atonement for am concerning im error wey e commit, and e no know am, and e go dey forgiven.
E na trespass offering. Surely e dey guilty before di Lord.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“If anyone sin, and commit one trespass against di Lord, and deal falsely with im neighbour about one deposit, or one security, or one robbery, or don oppress im neighbour,
or don find wetin dey lost, and deal falsely about am, and swear falsely, for any of all dem things wey man dey do, sinning therein,
if e don sin, and dey guilty, e go restore wetin e take by robbery, or di thing wey e get by oppression, or di deposit wey dem commit to am, or di lost thing wey e find,
or any thing about wey e don swear falsely. E go restore am in full, and go add di fifth part more to am. E go give am to am to whom e belong, for di day of im being found guilty.
E go bring im trespass offering to di Lord, one ram without blemish from di flock, according to your valuation, for one trespass offering, to di priest.
Di priest go make atonement for am before di Lord, and e go dey forgiven for any of all dat e do wey make am guilty.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“Command Aaron and im pikin man dem, talk, ‘Dis na di law of di burnt offering: di burnt offering go stay on di hearth upon di altar all night until di morning, and di fire of di altar go dey burning for am.
Di priest go put on im linen garment, and e go put im linen trousers on im body. E go take up di ashes wey di fire don consume of di burnt offering for di altar, and put dem beside di altar.
E go take off im garments, and put on other garments, and carry di ashes outside di camp to one clean place.
Di fire on di altar go dey burning for am. E no go go out. Di priest go burn wood on am every morning. E go lay di burnt offering in order on am, and go burn on am di fat of di peace offerings.
Fire go dey burning continually on di altar. E no go go out.
Dis na di law of di meal offering: di pikin dem of Aaron go offer am before di Lord, before di altar.

One go take from am im handful, of di fine flour of di meal offering, and of im oil, and all di frankincense wey dey on di meal offering, and go burn am on di altar for pleasing aroma, as im memorial portion, to di Lord.
Wetin remain of am Aaron and im pikin man dem go eat. E go dey eaten without leaven for one holy place. For di court of di Tent of Meeting dem go eat am.
E no go dey baked with leaven. I don give am as dem portion of my offerings made by fire. E na most holy, as di sin offering, and as di trespass offering.
Every male among di pikin dem of Aaron go eat am, as dem portion forever throughout una generations, from di offerings of di Lord made by fire. Whatever touch dem go dey holy.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“Dis na di offering of Aaron and of im pikin man dem, wey dem go offer to di Lord for di day wey e dey anointed: di tenth part of one ephah of fine flour for one meal offering perpetually, half of am for morning, and half of am for evening.
E go dey made with oil for one griddle. When e dey soaked, you go bring am in. Di baked pieces of di meal offering you go offer for pleasing aroma to di Lord.
Di anointed priest wey go succeed am from among im pikin man dem go offer am. E na one perpetual statute. E go dey wholly burnt to di Lord.
Every meal offering of di priest go dey wholly burnt. E no go dey eaten.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to Aaron and to im pikin man dem, talk, ‘Dis na di law of di sin offering: for di place wia dem dey kill di burnt offering dem go kill di sin offering before di Lord. E na most holy.
Di priest wey offer am for sin go eat am. E go dey eaten for one holy place, for di court of di Tent of Meeting.
Whatever touch im flesh go dey holy. When any of im blood dey sprinkled on any garment, you go wash dat on wey e dey sprinkled for one holy place.
But di earthen vessel wey dem boil am for go dey broken. If e dey boiled for one bronze vessel, e go dey scoured, and rinsed with water.
Every male among di priests go eat of am. E na most holy.
No sin offering, from wey any of di blood dey brought into di Tent of Meeting to make atonement for di holy place, go dey eaten. E go dey burnt with fire.’”
“Dis na di law of di trespass offering. E na most holy.
For di place wia dem dey kill di burnt offering dem go kill di trespass offering, and im blood e go sprinkle around on di altar.
E go offer all im fat: di fat tail, and di fat wey cover di inner parts,
and di two kidneys, and di fat wey dey on dem, wey dey by di loins, and di cover on di liver, with di kidneys, e go remove.
Di priest go burn dem on di altar for one offering made by fire to di Lord. E na trespass offering.
Every male among di priests go eat of am. E go dey eaten for one holy place. E na most holy.
As di sin offering dey, so di trespass offering dey. Dere dey one law for dem. Di priest wey make atonement with am go get am.
Di priest wey offer any man burnt offering go get for imself di skin of di burnt offering wey e don offer.
Every meal offering wey dem bake for di oven, and all wey dem prepare for di frying pan, and for di griddle, go be di priest own wey offer am.
Every meal offering, mixed with oil, or dry, go be all di pikin dem of Aaron own, one as much as another.
Dis na di law of di sacrifice of peace offerings, wey one go offer to di Lord.

If e offer am for thanksgiving, e go offer with di sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil, of fine flour well soaked.
With cakes of leavened bread e go offer im offering with di sacrifice of im peace offerings for thanksgiving.
Of am e go offer one from each offering for one heave offering to di Lord. E go be di priest own wey sprinkle di blood of di peace offerings.
Di flesh of di sacrifice of im peace offerings for thanksgiving go dey eaten on di day of im offering. E no go leave any of am until morning.
But if di sacrifice of im offering na one vow, or one free will offering, e go dey eaten for di day wey e offer im sacrifice. Di next day wetin remain of am go dey eaten,
but di remainder of di flesh of di sacrifice on di third day go dey burnt with fire.

If any of di flesh of di sacrifice of im peace offerings dey eaten at all on di third day, e no go dey accepted, neither go e dey credited to am wey offer am. E go be one abomination, and di soul wey eat of am go bear im iniquity.
Di flesh wey touch any unclean thing no go dey eaten. E go dey burnt with fire. As for di flesh, everyone wey dey clean go eat of am.
But di soul wey eat of di flesh of di sacrifice of peace offerings, wey belong to di Lord, having im uncleanness upon am, dat soul go dey cut off from im people.

When anyone touch any unclean thing, di uncleanness of man, or one unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eat of di flesh of di sacrifice of peace offerings, wey belong to di Lord, dat soul go dey cut off from im people.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘Una no go eat any fat, of ox, or sheep, or goat.
Di fat of dat wey die of itself, and di fat of dat wey animals tear, fit dey used for any other service, but una no go eat am.
Because whoever eat di fat of di animal, from wey men offer one offering made by fire to di Lord, even di soul wey eat am go dey cut off from im people.
Una no go eat any blood, whether of bird or of animal, for any of una dwellings.
Whoever eat any blood, dat soul go dey cut off from im people.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘Di one wey offer im sacrifice of peace offerings to di Lord go bring im offering to di Lord out of di sacrifice of im peace offerings.
With im own hands e go bring di offerings of di Lord made by fire. Di fat with di breast e go bring, so that di breast go dey waved for wave offering before di Lord.
Di priest go burn di fat on di altar, but di breast go be Aaron own and im pikin man dem own.
Di right thigh una go give to di priest for one heave offering out of di sacrifices of una peace offerings.
Di one among Aaron pikin man dem wey offer di blood of di peace offerings, and di fat, go get di right thigh for im portion.

Because di wave breast and di heave thigh I don take of di pikin dem of Israel out of di sacrifices of dem peace offerings, and I don give dem to Aaron di priest and to im pikin man dem as dem portion forever from among di pikin dem of Israel.’”

Dis na di anointing portion of Aaron, and di anointing portion of im pikin man dem, from di offerings of di Lord made by fire, for di day wey e present dem to minister to di Lord for di priest office,
wey di Lord command to give dem, for di day wey e anoint dem, from among di pikin dem of Israel. E na one perpetual statute throughout dem generations.
Dis na di law of di burnt offering, of di meal offering, and of di sin offering, and of di trespass offering, and of di setting apart, and of di sacrifice of peace offerings,
wey di Lord command Moses for Mount Sinai, for di day wey e command di pikin dem of Israel to offer dem offerings to di Lord, for di wilderness of Sinai.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Take Aaron and im pikin man dem with am, and di garments, and di anointing oil, and di bull of di sin offering, and di two rams, and di basket of unleavened bread,
and gather all di congregation together to di door of di Tent of Meeting.”
Moses do as di Lord command am, and di congregation dey gathered together to di door of di Tent of Meeting.
Moses talk to di congregation, “Dis na di thing wey di Lord command to dey done.”
Moses bring Aaron and im pikin man dem, and wash dem with water.
E put on am di coat, and gird am with di sash, and clothe am with di robe, and put di ephod on am, and gird am with di skillfully woven band of di ephod, and bind di ephod to am with am.
E put di breastplate on am, and put in di breastplate di Urim and di Thummim.
E set di turban on im head, and on di turban, for im front, e set di golden plate, di holy crown, as di Lord command Moses.
Moses take di anointing oil, and anoint di tabernacle and all wey dey inside am, and make dem holy.
E sprinkle am on di altar seven times, and anoint di altar and all im vessels, and di basin and im base, to make dem holy.
E pour some of di anointing oil on Aaron head, and anoint am, to make am holy.
Moses bring Aaron pikin man dem, and clothe dem with coats, and gird dem with sashes, and bind headbands on dem, as di Lord command Moses.
E bring di bull of di sin offering, and Aaron and im pikin man dem lay dem hands on di head of di bull of di sin offering.

E kill am, and Moses take di blood, and put am on di horns of di altar round about with im finger, and purify di altar, and pour out di blood at di base of di altar, and make am holy, to make atonement for am.
E take all di fat wey dey on di inner parts, and di cover of di liver, and di two kidneys, and dem fat, and Moses burn am on di altar.
But di bull, and im skin, and im flesh, and im dung, e burn with fire outside di camp, as di Lord command Moses.
E present di ram of di burnt offering, and Aaron and im pikin man dem lay dem hands on di head of di ram.
E kill am, and Moses sprinkle di blood around on di altar.
E cut di ram into im pieces. Moses burn di head, and di pieces, and di fat.
E wash di inner parts and di legs with water. Moses burn all di ram on di altar. E na burnt offering for pleasing aroma. E na offering made by fire to di Lord, as di Lord command Moses.
E present di other ram, di ram of setting apart, and Aaron and im pikin man dem lay dem hands on di head of di ram.
E kill am, and Moses take some of im blood, and put am on di tip of Aaron right ear, and on di thumb of im right hand, and on di big toe of im right foot.

E bring Aaron pikin man dem, and Moses put some of di blood on di tip of dem right ear, and on di thumb of dem right hand, and on di big toe of dem right foot. Moses sprinkle di blood on di altar round about.
E take di fat, and di fat tail, and all di fat wey dey on di inner parts, and di cover of di liver, and di two kidneys, and dem fat, and di right thigh.
Out of di basket of unleavened bread, wey dey before di Lord, e take one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put dem on di fat, and on di right thigh.
E put all dis on Aaron hands, and on di hands of im pikin man dem, and wave dem for wave offering before di Lord.
Moses take dem from dem hands, and burn dem on di altar on top of di burnt offering. Dem na offerings of setting apart for pleasing aroma. E na one offering made by fire to di Lord.
Moses take di breast, and wave am for wave offering before di Lord. Na Moses portion of di ram of setting apart, as di Lord command Moses.

Moses take some of di anointing oil, and of di blood wey dey on di altar, and sprinkle am on Aaron, on im garments, and on im pikin man dem, and on im pikin man dem garments with am. E make Aaron holy, and im garments, and im pikin man dem, and im pikin man dem garments with am.

Moses talk to Aaron and to im pikin man dem, “Boil di flesh for di door of di Tent of Meeting, and dere eat am and di bread wey dey di basket of setting apart, as I command, talk, ‘Aaron and im pikin man dem go eat am.’
Wetin remain of di flesh and of di bread una go burn with fire.
Una no go go out from di door of di Tent of Meeting for seven days, until di days of una setting apart dey fulfilled, because seven days e go set una apart.
As e don do dis day, so di Lord don command to do, to make atonement for una.
Una go stay at di door of di Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep di charge of di Lord, so that una no go die, because na so dem command me.”
Aaron and im pikin man dem do all di things wey di Lord command by Moses.
E come be say for di eighth day, Moses call Aaron and im pikin man dem, and di elders of Israel.
E talk to Aaron, “Take for yourself one bull calf for sin offering, and one ram for burnt offering, without blemish, and offer dem before di Lord.
Una go speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘Take one male goat for sin offering, and one calf and one lamb, both one year old, without blemish, for burnt offering,
and one ox and one ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before di Lord, and one meal offering mixed with oil, because today di Lord go appear to una.’”
Dem bring wetin Moses command before di Tent of Meeting, and all di congregation come near and stand before di Lord.
Moses talk, “Dis na di thing wey di Lord command una to do, and di glory of di Lord go appear to una.”

Moses talk to Aaron, “Draw near to di altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for di people. Offer di offering of di people, and make atonement for dem, as di Lord command.”
So Aaron draw near to di altar, and kill di calf of di sin offering, wey be for imself.
Aaron pikin man dem present di blood to am. E dip im finger for di blood, and put am on di horns of di altar, and pour out di blood at di base of di altar.
But di fat, and di kidneys, and di cover from di liver of di sin offering, e burn on di altar, as di Lord command Moses.
Di flesh and di skin e burn with fire outside di camp.
E kill di burnt offering. Aaron pikin man dem deliver to am di blood, and e sprinkle am around on di altar.
Dem deliver di burnt offering to am, piece by piece, and di head, and e burn dem on di altar.
E wash di inner parts and di legs, and burn dem on top of di burnt offering for di altar.
E present di people offering, and take di goat of di sin offering wey be for di people, and kill am, and offer am for sin, like di first.
E present di burnt offering, and offer am according to di ordinance.
E present di meal offering, and fill im hand from am, and burn am on di altar, besides di burnt offering of di morning.
E kill di ox and di ram, di sacrifice of peace offerings, wey be for di people. Aaron pikin man dem deliver to am di blood, wey e sprinkle around on di altar,
and di fat of di ox and of di ram, di fat tail, and wetin cover di inner parts, and di kidneys, and di cover of di liver,
and dem put di fat on di breasts, and e burn di fat on di altar.
Di breasts and di right thigh Aaron wave for wave offering before di Lord, as Moses command.
Aaron lift up im hands toward di people, and bless dem. E come down from offering di sin offering, and di burnt offering, and di peace offerings.
Moses and Aaron go into di Tent of Meeting, and come out, and bless di people. Di glory of di Lord appear to all di people.
Fire come out from before di Lord, and consume di burnt offering and di fat on di altar. When all di people see am, dem shout, and fall on dem faces.
Nadab and Abihu, Aaron pikin man dem, each take im censer, and put fire inside am, and put incense on am, and offer strange fire before di Lord, wey e no command dem.
Fire come out from before di Lord, and devour dem, and dem die before di Lord.
Moses talk to Aaron, “Dis na wetin di Lord speak, talk, ‘I go dey made holy for dem wey come near me, and before all di people I go dey glorified.’” Aaron hold im peace.
Moses call Mishael and Elzaphan, di pikin dem of Uzziel di uncle of Aaron, and talk to dem, “Come near, carry your brothers from before di sanctuary go outside di camp.”
So dem come near, and carry dem in dem coats outside di camp, as Moses talk.

Moses talk to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, im pikin man dem, “No uncover your heads, neither tear your clothes, so that una no go die, and so that wrath no go come on all di congregation. But make una brothers, di whole house of Israel, mourn di burning wey di Lord don kindle.
Una no go go out from di door of di Tent of Meeting, otherwise una go die, because di anointing oil of di Lord dey on una.” Dem do according to di word of Moses.
Di Lord speak to Aaron, talk,
“Una no go drink wine nor strong drink, you, nor your pikin man dem with you, when una go into di Tent of Meeting, so that una no go die. E go be one perpetual statute throughout una generations,
and so that una go make difference between di holy and di common, and between di unclean and di clean,
and so that una go teach di pikin dem of Israel all di statutes wey di Lord don speak to dem by di hand of Moses.”

Moses speak to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, im pikin man dem wey remain, “Take di meal offering wey remain of di offerings of di Lord made by fire, and eat am without leaven beside di altar, because e dey most holy.
Una go eat am for one holy place, because e na your portion and your pikin man dem portion, of di offerings of di Lord made by fire, because na so dem command me.

Di wave breast and di heave thigh una go eat for one clean place, you, and your pikin man dem, and your pikin woman dem with you, because dem dey given as your portion and your pikin dem portion, out of di sacrifices of di peace offerings of di pikin dem of Israel.

Di heave thigh and di wave breast dem go bring with di offerings of di fat made by fire, to wave am for wave offering before di Lord. E go be yours, and your pikin dem with you, by one statute forever, as di Lord don command.”
Moses diligently enquire about di goat of di sin offering, and look, e dey burnt. E dey angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, di pikin man dem of Aaron wey remain, talk,
“Why una no eat di sin offering for di place of di sanctuary, seeing say e dey most holy, and e dey given to una to bear di iniquity of di congregation, to make atonement for dem before di Lord?
Look, di blood of am no dey brought into di inner part of di sanctuary. Una for don eat am for di sanctuary, as I command.”

Aaron talk to Moses, “Look, today dem don offer dem sin offering and dem burnt offering before di Lord. Dem kind things don happen to me. If I for don eat di sin offering today, e for dey accepted for di sight of di Lord?”
When Moses hear dat, e dey content.
